parts.label: Sunlight
parts.note: The Sun always lights the half of the Moon facing it

parts.label: Earth
parts.note: We see the Moon from here

parts.label: New moon
parts.note: Lit side faces away from us: we see nothing

parts.label: First quarter
parts.note: Half lit: one week after new moon

parts.label: Full moon
parts.note: The whole lit face points at us

parts.label: Third quarter
parts.note: The other half lit: one week after full

parts.label: Crescent
parts.note: A thin sliver: waxing means growing

parts.label: Gibbous
parts.note: More than half lit: waning means shrinking
